THIS EASEMENT AGREEMENT (the “Agreement")is made this 9th_day of
November
,2015, by and between Robert E. Green, Sr., Trustee of the Robert E.

82059,(the“Grantor”), and the City of Cheyenne, a municipal corporation organized under the laws
of the State of Wyoming, whose address is 2101 O'Neil Avenue, Cheyenne, WY 82001 (the
"Grantee").
1.RECITALS
A.The Grantor is the owner infee simple of certain real property located in Laramie
County, Wyoming, more particularly described on Exhibit A attached hereto and byreference
incorporated herein(the"Grantor's Property").
B.
The Grantor's Property is encumbered by a Deed of Conservation Easement held by
The Nature Conservancy (the“Conservancy") recorded February 27,2015 at Reception #655698,
Book 2431, Page 648 in the Public Records in Laramie County, Wyoming (the“Conservation
Easement").
C.
Grantee proposes todevelop and maintain a public trails system and open space area
called the Bel voir Ranch and Red Mountain(Big Hole) Open Space (the“Open Space Program")
over property which is adjacent to and in the vicinity of Grantor's Property.
D.
Grantor desires to grant to Grantee a trail easement(The Robert E.Green Trail) over
and across Grantor's Property to be used in conjunction with the Open Space Program for the
limited purposes and terms as described herein.

NOW, THEREFORE, for Ten and no/100Dollars($10.00)and other valuable consideration,
thereceipt and sufficiency of whichis hereby acknowledged, the parties hereto agree asfollows:
1.
Conveyance of Public Trail Easement.Grantor hereby grants to Grantee a non-
exclusive easement (the “Easement") for non-motorized hiking and biking uses, as is more
particularly depicted on Exhibit B attached hereto and incorporated herein by this reference, subject
to theterms, conditions and limitations set forth herein.The Ease ment will consist ofa corridorone
hundred feet(1oo') in width and shall run from point topoint as identified in Exhibit B.The trail
corridor will be further identified by GIS coordinates of thepoint atwhich an access gate will be
installed near a parking lot located on the Grantor's property and the points at which the trail
corridor will intersect the boundary between the Grantor's and Grantee's properties.It is mutually
understood and agreed that prior to construction, the alignment of theinitial trail corridormay be
altered if necessary to accommodate areas that are sensitive due to archeological, endangered
species, and other findings that may affect the conservation values of the Conservation Easement.
Afterthe trailis constructed, the Ease ment will be fifty feet(So')in width centered on the center line
of the constructed trail.All ingress and egress points to the trail easement will be controlled by "V""
gates to prevent motorized vehicular access to the trail easement.
2.Conservation Easement. The parties acknowledge and agree that the Easement is
subordinate and subject to the terms and conditions of the Conservation Ease ment.To the extent
there exists a conflict in terms or conditions between the Conservation Ease ment and this Ease ment,
the Conservation Ease ment shall control.
3.Limitations on Grant and Conveyances. In granting the Easement, Grantor expressly
represents that Grantor does not:
A.Extend any assurance that the Easement is safe for any purpose;
B.
Confer upon any member of the public the legal status of an invitee or
licensee to whom a duty or careis owed by Grantor; or
C.
Assume responsibility or incur any liability for injury to person orproperty
or for the death of any person caused by the use of the Easement.
4.
Management of the Easement.
A.
Except as necessary to construct the Robert E. Green Trail, Grantee shall
oversee andmanage the Easement so astopromote, protect and preserve the
Easement in its present natural, essentially undisturbed state, and the
Grantor's use and enjoyment of the Grantor's Property.Such oversight and
management shall be consistent with the concepts and general principles
contained in this Agreement.
